_readme: Meridian execution config. Default is signals-only: signals are displayed, nothing is submitted.
The credential comes from process.env.OANDA. It is never read from this file.
Every setting is labelled with where its value came from: OWNER (the owner supplied it in
ownerSettings), DEMO TEST (the values the owner directed for a Practice-only demo run), or
TEST (a labelled test value). A setting with none of those is UNSET and nothing trades.
DEMO TEST is the profile active below: 0.1% risk per trade, at most 1 open Meridian trade,
0.5% daily loss threshold, and every other one of the twelve required settings stated
explicitly in lib/config.ts (DEMO_TEST_PROFILE). It is NOT the owner's real risk settings and
must never be presented as their appetite for risk; it is labelled DEMO TEST in the execution
record and on the console. Exactly one labelled profile may be active, so useTestProfile stays
false: flipping it on would apply the older TEST values instead, or refuse outright.
Mode stays signals-only, automatic execution is not acknowledged, and neither strategy is
enabled. The profile cannot change the trading host: the host is a frozen constant in
lib/interlock.ts and the order path asserts it on every request.
